backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with authorization plus feedback submission and admin-only retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a homepage banner addition and related files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summarized descriptions of all frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React app routing setup using TanStack Router with root layout and all page routes.
frontend/src/components/models/auctions/: Auction model selector displaying calculators for first‑price, second‑price, and sealed‑bid formats.
React UI for computing a first‑price auction bid using a simple (n‑1)/n strategy, with validation and explanation output.
Calculator for sealed‑bid auctions that adjusts the (n‑1)/n bid based on risk attitude and displays tailored explanations.
Second‑price auction tool that recommends truthful bidding and explains Vickrey logic with basic input validation.
frontend/src/components/models/bargainin: Implements a Nash bargaining calculator that computes surplus splits from inputs and returns the resulting allocation explanation.
frontend/src/components/models/entry/Mar: Analyzes a 2×2 market‑entry game to detect pure‑strategy Nash equilibria, generate recommendations, and visualize payoffs.
frontend/src/components/models/ModelAssu: Alert component listing simplifying model assumptions.
frontend/src/components/PageLayout.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper providing consistent spacing and optional title/description.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with site info, quick links, social icons, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with logo, desktop nav, and mobile sheet navigation.
frontend/src/components/visualizations/P: Visual component that displays a payoff matrix and highlights cells corresponding to provided Nash equilibria.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, reinitializing on identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and utilities for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: Defines a mutation that submits feedback through the backend actor and invalidates feedback-related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutGameTheoryPage.t: Renders an informational page explaining core game theory concepts using cards and accordions.
frontend/src/pages/CaseStudiesPage.tsx: Displays multiple game-theory case studies with structured details and navigation integration.
frontend/src/pages/ContactFeedbackPage.t: Implements a feedback form with validation, submission handling, and success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page with creator banner, hero section, and feature cards linking to models and quiz.
frontend/src/pages/InteractiveModelsPage: Interactive models page using tabs to switch between auction, market entry, and bargaining models.
frontend/src/pages/LearningResourcesPage: Page listing learning resources by difficulty with downloadable materials and categorized cards.
frontend/src/pages/QuizSimulationPage.ts: Quiz page presenting multiple‑choice game theory questions with feedback, scoring, and navigation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and used plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing features, issues, and metadata for the Strategic Game Theory app.
